# A1 Transmission

A1 Transmission is an auto repair shop at 20146 Saticoy Street B1, Winnetka, CA 91306. The shop opened in April 1995 and serves Winnetka and the San Fernando Valley. Phone: (818) 882-5135. Email: Kf6ymf@gmail.com. Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–6:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM–12:00 PM, Sunday closed.

Transmission diagnosis is free. Transmission repair is backed by a 12,000-mile / 1-year warranty on parts and labor, whichever comes first. The only shop is in Winnetka. Canoga Park is a service area, not a second storefront.

## Services

- Automatic and manual transmission rebuild and repair
- Transmission full fluid flush
- Clutch service and repair
- Brake repair and brake system fluid service
- Axle differential repair and drive shaft replacement
- Transfer case and 4x4 repair
